summary: Fix the assistant covering the PDF and the sidebar layout. The floating orb is hidden while the reader is open and the toolbar button opens the panel; when the panel is open the page area reflows (margin) instead of being covered. Questions can be sent with no selection, and six suggested-question chips make asking one click. Sidebar thumbnails no longer shrink (fixed 120px, flex:0 0 auto), the sidebar scrolls, and thumbnails render lazily via IntersectionObserver.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 35d7d95. Static UI only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: Layout/UI work only; no model call and no budget/config change.
budget_impact.before: Orb and panel covered the reader; no suggested questions; sidebar thumbs compressed and were rendered eagerly.
budget_impact.after: Orb hidden in the reader, panel reflows the page, suggestion chips, scrollable 120px thumbnails with lazy rendering.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Both scripts parse after the edits

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: The reflow width (424px) and chip wrapping are judged from CSS, not visually verified.
Suggested questions are static and not tailored per paper.
Large PDFs keep all canvases in memory.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
